subject: CPA Funding Guidelines and Application Schedule
overview: The Community Preservation Committee presented an informational overview of the Community Preservation Act funding process, available reserves, project eligibility criteria, and the 2019–2020 application schedule.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Overview
items.summary: Roberta Cameron provided background on the Community Preservation Act, detailing how local property tax surcharges and state matching funds support open space, recreation, historic preservation, and affordable housing.

items.title: Available FY 2019 Funding and Small Grants Program
items.summary: Cameron reviewed the approximately $1.9 million currently available in CPA reserves and introduced a new rolling small grants program allocating $50,000 for projects requesting up to $5,000.

items.title: Applicant Eligibility and Project Requirements
items.summary: Cameron outlined eligibility requirements for applicants and capital improvement projects, emphasizing that municipal property proposals require prior coordination with the mayor's office.

items.title: Application Steps and Evaluation Criteria
items.summary: Cameron detailed the application process, which requires an eligibility determination form before full project proposals are reviewed against committee evaluation criteria.

items.title: Funding Cycle Timeline
items.summary: Cameron presented the application schedule leading to anticipated City Council votes in January 2020, noting that the single longer cycle was designed to align with the city's fiscal calendar.
